build.beforeDevCommand: bash -lc 'set -uo pipefail; ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); cd "$ROOT"; mkdir -p runtime/dev/logs; LOG=runtime/dev/logs/vite.log; echo "[tauri.dev] $(date -Is) starting vite" >> "$LOG"; trap "exit 0" INT TERM; if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1 && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5173 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[tauri.dev] Vite déjà actif sur :5173 — skip beforeDevCommand" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 0; fi; export PATH="$ROOT/.tools/node/current/bin:$PATH"; PNPM="$ROOT/.tools/node/current/bin/pnpm"; if [ ! -x "$PNPM" ]; then PNPM=$(command -v pnpm || true); fi; if [ -z "${PNPM:-}" ]; then echo "[tauri.dev] ERROR: pnpm introuvable" | tee -a "$LOG"; exit 1; fi; "$PNPM" exec vite dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"; ec=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; if [ "\${ec:-0}" -ge 128 ]; then exit 0; fi; exit "\${ec:-0}"'

bundle.longDescription: TITANE∞ Dev Runtime - Development environment with full debugging, monitoring, and experimental features.
